Roborock Q5 Pro+ replacement parts.

For the Roborock Q5 Pro+ with RockDock Plus. It uses the Q5 Pro robot platform with DuoRoller main brushes and a removable mop cloth, plus an auto-empty dock with a 2.5 L E12-rated dust bag. Confirm your model and selected pack before ordering.

Check the variant: Q5 Pro+ is different from Q5+. Roborock shows the Q5+ with a single brush and no mop; the Q5 Pro+ has DuoRoller brushes, a removable mop cloth and RockDock Plus. Do not choose a part just because an Amazon listing says Q5: check that it names Q5 Pro+ and verify dock-bag fit separately.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

Q5 Pro+ vs. Q5+
Roborock's comparison identifies Q5 Pro+ with DuoRoller brushes and a detachable mop; Q5+ has a single brush and no mop. Check the full model name on the robot or in the app before choosing a part.
Robot filter vs. dock dust bag
The washable filter sits in the robot's dustbin. The disposable 2.5 L E12-rated dust bag sits in the RockDock Plus. They are different parts and cannot replace one another.
DuoRoller main brushes
The Q5 Pro+ uses two parallel rubber rollers. Select a dual-roller replacement that names Q5 Pro+; do not substitute a single-bristle Q5+ brush.
Dock bags inside third-party kits
The linked CHAIN PEAK kit lists Q5 Pro+ and includes six dock bags, but does not publish their capacity. Roborock specifies a 2.5 L E12-rated RockDock Plus bag. Check the bag collar and size against your original before buying.
Multi-model listings
Several third-party listings also name Q8 Max, Q5 Max+ or other models. This guide reports each seller's exact claim; it does not assume every component fits all models in a shared listing.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock Q5 Pro+ maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Roborock Q5 Pro+ cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
DuoRoller main brushesEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Side brushMonthlyEvery 3–6 months
Washable robot-bin filterEvery weekEvery 6–12 months
Mop clothAfter each useEvery 3–6 months
RockDock Plus dust bagDisposableAs required

Rinse the washable robot filter with clean water only and let the filter and dustbin dry thoroughly before reinstalling. Remove and wash the mop cloth after use. Keep a dust bag installed whenever the auto-empty dock runs.

Before you order

Are Roborock Q5 Pro+ and Q5+ replacement parts the same?

Do not assume so. Roborock describes the Q5 Pro+ with DuoRoller brushes and a detachable mop, while its Q5+ comparison shows a single brush and no mop. Match each part to the full model name and the original component.

Which filter does the Q5 Pro+ use?

The robot has a washable filter inside its dustbin. The RockDock Plus uses a separate disposable dust bag. The filter listing on this page is third-party and names Q5 Pro+; match its frame and latch to your original filter.

What size dust bag does the Q5 Pro+ dock use?

Roborock specifies a 2.5 L E12-rated dust bag for RockDock Plus and says to replace it as required. The linked third-party kit names Q5 Pro+ but does not state bag capacity, so compare the collar and dimensions with your installed bag.

Are these genuine Roborock replacement parts?

No. The linked filters, brushes, mop cloths and multi-part kit are third-party products; their Q5 Pro+ compatibility statements come from their Amazon sellers. The robot link is an Amazon Renewed refurbished listing, not a new robot offer.
